about: Retrieval eval. A synthetic shampoo usage-and-attitude questionnaire, QC findings and taught lessons, and labelled searches as researchers type them. Scored by scripts/eval_retrieval.py: recall@1, recall@3 and MRR for meaning-only, words-only and hybrid ranking, on whichever embedder is available. Types: synonym (no word in common), code (a question code), words (shared words), typo, finding, lesson. Searches marked held_out were written after the glossary (src/engines/rag/glossary.py) was frozen; report them separately, never tune the glossary on them.

pieces.text: S1. What is your age? Answers: Under 18; 18-24; 25-34; 35-44; 45-54; 55+
S2. How do you describe yourself? Answers: Man; Woman; Non-binary; Prefer not to say
S3. In which city do you currently live? Answers: Mumbai; Delhi; Bengaluru; Chennai; Kolkata; Other
S4. Do you or anyone in your household work in any of these industries? Answers: Market research; Advertising; Personal care manufacturing; None of these
S5. In the past month, which of these have you personally bought? Answers: Shampoo; Conditioner; Hair oil; Hair colour; None of these
Q1. When you think of shampoo brands, which ones come to mind? Please list all you can think of.
Q2. Which of these shampoo brands have you heard of? Answers: Clinic Plus; Dove; Head & Shoulders; Pantene; Sunsilk; TRESemmé
Q3. Which of these brands would you consider buying next time? Answers: Clinic Plus; Dove; Head & Shoulders; Pantene; Sunsilk; TRESemmé
Q4. Which brand of shampoo do you use most often? Answers: Clinic Plus; Dove; Head & Shoulders; Pantene; Sunsilk; TRESemmé; Other
Q5. How long have you been using this brand? Answers: Less than 6 months; 6-12 months; 1-3 years; More than 3 years
Q6. How often do you wash your hair with shampoo? Answers: Every day; 4-6 times a week; 2-3 times a week; Once a week; Less often
Q7. Where do you usually buy your shampoo? Answers: Local kirana store; Supermarket; Pharmacy; Online marketplace; Salon
Q8. Which pack size do you usually buy? Answers: Sachet; 80 ml bottle; 180 ml bottle; 340 ml bottle; 650 ml or larger
Q9. Roughly how much did you pay for your last bottle of shampoo, in rupees?
Q10. At what price would this shampoo start to seem too expensive to consider buying?
Q11. At what price would it seem so cheap that you would doubt its quality?
Q12. How would you describe your hair type? Answers: Straight; Wavy; Curly; Coily
Q13. Which hair problems do you face? Answers: Dandruff; Hair fall; Frizz; Dryness; Oily scalp; Split ends; None
Q14. Which hair problem bothers you the most?
Q15. How satisfied are you with your current shampoo on each of the following? Rows: Cleansing; Fragrance; Softness; Dandruff control; Value for money. Scale: Very dissatisfied to Very satisfied
Q16. How likely are you to recommend your current shampoo brand to a friend or colleague? 0 = Not at all likely, 10 = Extremely likely
Q17. Why did you give that score? Please explain in your own words.
Q18. How important is each of these when choosing a shampoo? Rows: Natural ingredients; Price; Fragrance; Brand reputation; Doctor recommended. Scale: Not at all important to Extremely important
Q19. Do you prefer shampoos that are free from sulphates and parabens? Answers: Yes, always; Sometimes; No; Don't know what these are
Q20. Have you switched shampoo brands in the past year? Answers: Yes; No
Q21. What made you switch from your previous brand?
Q22. Where have you seen or heard about shampoo brands recently? Answers: TV advertisement; Instagram or YouTube; Influencer; Store display; Friends or family
Q23. Have you ever bought a shampoo because of a discount or a free gift? Answers: Yes, often; Occasionally; Never
Q24. Please rank these new shampoo ideas from most to least appealing. Items: Onion oil anti-hairfall; Rice water shine; Charcoal deep clean; Ayurvedic herbal
Q25. Thinking of the Rice water shine shampoo, how likely would you be to buy it at Rs 199? Answers: Definitely would buy; Probably would buy; Might or might not; Probably not; Definitely not
Q26. What, if anything, would stop you from buying it?
Q27. Do you use a conditioner after shampooing? Answers: Every time; Sometimes; Never
Q28. Who in your household decides which shampoo is bought? Answers: Me; My spouse or partner; A parent; We decide together
D1. What is the highest level of education you have completed? Answers: School; Graduate; Postgraduate; Doctorate
D2. What is your monthly household income? Answers: Below Rs 25,000; Rs 25,000-50,000; Rs 50,000-1,00,000; Above Rs 1,00,000
D3. How many people live in your household, including you?
QC finding on S1 (screen_out_leak, high): 4 respondents aged under 18 completed the survey — 4 rows
QC finding on Q15 (straightlining, medium): 31 respondents gave the same answer on every row of the satisfaction grid — 31 rows
QC finding on Q9 (out_of_range, low): last price paid above Rs 5,000 for a shampoo bottle — 2 rows
Taught rule for hul_fmt: [SA] marks a single-choice question (in the document, "[SA]" -> single)
Taught rule for hul_fmt: [ROTATE] means the options are shown in random order
Correction about Q15 (resolved): the grid rows were read as five separate questions; they belong to one satisfaction grid
